Alicia — great to meet earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery call so we have alignment before I send an official estimate.

Notes from the call:
- Expected usage: ~25M input+output tokens / month to start, with seasonal spikes to ~40M.
- Workload: customer support summaries + search reranking + a short-form assistant (avg seq len ~512).
- SLOs: p95 latency target <= 250ms for the assistant queries; some non-critical batch jobs can be queued.

High-level pricing posture (preliminary):
- Hosted API (pay-as-you-go): target unit economics $/1M tokens in the range $250 — $350 depending on model family and caching.
- Dedicated / reserved capacity (if you want predictable throughput): economics closer to $120 — $180 per 1M effective tokens with a monthly commit and some minimum term.

Open items I need from you to finalize an estimate:
1) Confirmation of the budget owner and economic buyer who will approve pricing.
2) Any target $/1M tokens you have in mind (e.g., what finance considers reasonable for a 25M TPM workload).
3) Whether procurement/finance requires a PO/SOW or Vendor Docusign before committed pricing.

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm the budget owner and whether you prefer Hosted vs Dedicated pricing range, I can send a formal one-page estimate + MPA for review by EOD next business day.
- Schedule a 30-min procurement/finance review if needed (I can loop in our finance lead).

Attaching a short outline of the pricing bands and a proposed mutual action plan for timelines. Let me know who from your side should be looped in for sign-off (Tom? Maria?).

Attachment: redwood_pricing_outline.pdf (PDF, 28KB)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and attachments. Helpful. Quick answers below.

1) Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (VP of Engineering) — he signs off on platform spend that impacts engineering budgets.
2) Budget owner for vendor/contract: Maria Santos (CFO). Maria will own the PO/finance approval.
3) Finance/procurement process: procurement@finex.ai will require a standard vendor questionnaire + SOW before issuing a PO. Typical turnaround for a known vendor is 7–10 business days once we have completed docs.

A little color on target economics from our side: for a 25M TPM run-rate finance is looking for an initial target of ~$300/1M tokens on hosted solutions. If a dedicated reserved model delivers >50% savings and predictable latencies, Maria is open to exploring a committed offer but will need clear delta vs hosted price.

I can set up a 30-min sync with Tom + Maria + procurement early next week — Tue/Wed morning PT works for us. Can you propose 2 slots?
